entities.name: Éverton Lopes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Éverton dos Santos Lopes is a Brazilian professional boxer best known for his sensational 2011 World title win when he was still an amateur. Lopes is also a two-time Olympian, two-time Pan American Games medalist and 2013 AIBA World Boxing Championships bronze medalist.
